doc.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995

title: Recording sessions she attended, including Nat King Cole
summary: She never saw Joe record with Basie but attended many other sessions, remembering Nat King Cole singing in his hat.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: Did you ever, when Joe was with the Basie band, and they did some recordings, and I’m wondering if you ever got to see that process?

No, I never saw Joe and the Basie band record, no. I went to a number of recordings. I feel very privileged being with Joe to have met so many wonderful people. I remember going to a Nat King Cole recording once in New York. That was great. Nat sang with his hat on all the time, that was the only thing that bothered me, he had that checkered hat that he used to wear.
But what came out was pretty good.
Right, that was great. I’ve been to a lot of recording sessions, but never with the band.
